evidenceCoverage.baselineDescription: No pre-adoption comparison is included; observations begin at adoption.
evidenceCoverage.reason: No comparable pre-adoption outcome evaluation is established for this contract.

caveat: The evidence measures post-adoption attainment only; without a comparable pre-adoption baseline it cannot establish improvement or causation.

intent.goal: For temporary-ID smoke opportunities, resolve the six directed issue-body references into the correct real issues and establish the two requested parent-child relationships, independently joined to protected safe-output receipts.
intent.acceptance: A protected initial-attempt host receipt maps aw_test01, aw_test02 and aw_test03 to distinct stable GitHub issues; independent cutoff-valid bodies prove the six exact directed references, complete historical graph facts prove both children belong to that parent, and a protected comment receipt proves targeting of the mapped parent. Each known resolved reference counts independently of other missing dimensions.

evidence.opportunity: The six directed body references and two parent-child relationships per initial smoke execution; reruns do not create new work. Confirmed and unknown execution eligibility are separate; the eligible denominator is null wherever job history cannot establish it.
filters: Only github/gh-aw, exact immutable reviewed workflow profiles and a protected safe_outputs host execution bind the mapping; editable body markers are discovery only.
Initial attempt only; reruns remain inventoried but do not inflate delivered references.
The six body slots are parent-to-child1, parent-to-child2, child1-to-parent, child1-to-child2, child2-to-parent and child2-to-child1.
Two native graph links are measured separately; a Related to footer or fallback comment is not a parent relationship.
Mutable bodies observed after cutoff require a platform last-edit/update timestamp no later than cutoff; otherwise their historical state is unknown.
Current graph edges require exhaustive historical add/remove facts to reconstruct the cutoff; current graph state alone is not backdated.
No proof from successful runs, jobs, agent summaries, evals, unresolved placeholders, issue existence, edited footer IDs or group-parent issues.
Empty populations and all-unknown populations score null, never zero. A known incorrect slot scores zero only for that assessed dimension.
3-8 versus original 4-8 format, agent engine, telemetry and report-format changes do not alter the fixed aw_test01/02/03 goal. Other source changes require review.
The source describes the third ID as eight characters, but all three actual fixtures have six suffix characters. No broad length-coverage claim is made.
evidence.collection: Acquire the complete cutoff-bounded Actions inventory and every attempt, reuse the complete shared output-history discovery partitions, inspect all matching issue identities, acquire protected host job/log/artifact receipts, pin immutable workflow/runtime source, and independently project GitHub bodies and parent/sub-issue histories. Offline scoring never calls GitHub.

model.architecture: Independent GitHub body and graph state joined through protected host temporary-ID receipts.
model.recommendation: Report known native resolutions separately from unknown relationships and full acceptance; do not infer trend through evidence gaps.

metrics.name: Verified resolved body references
metrics.formula: Count independently verified directed body-reference slots whose actual issue target equals the protected temporary-ID mapping.

metrics.name: Verified child-parent graph links
metrics.formula: Count source-required child-parent edges reconstructed at the observation cutoff from complete independent GitHub graph history and protected issue mapping.

metrics.name: Fully accepted temporary-ID triplets
metrics.formula: Count triplets with all six reference slots, both graph edges and a protected summary comment receipt targeting the mapped parent.
